articles.title: Coast Guard Cutter Stratton Returns Home After Lengthy Northern Patrol
articles.summary: The crew of the Coast Guard cutter Stratton returned to their home port after a 103-day patrol in the Arctic and Bering Sea, where they worked to reinforce maritime safety, security and national sovereignty in one of the most demanding operating areas in the world.
